newsitem.title: USA: BPA raises Tues on-peak power to $46.00 per MWh.
newsitem.headline: BPA raises Tues on-peak power to $46.00 per MWh.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) nearly tripled its offer price for firm power during heavy load hours on Tuesday to as high as $46.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), the agency said Monday.
Firm peak power was offered at $45.00 per MWh to Northwest buyers and at $46.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) deliveries, up from $16.75 and $17.75, respectively, for Monday.
A trade source at BPA attributed the prices to higher daytime regional power demand and limitations on drafting from hydroelectric reservoirs.
Bonneville also offered firm and non-firm power during off-peak hours on Tuesday at $12.50 per MWh for all deliveries, compared with $10.50-11.50 for Monday.
